Name: Pasture Woods Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[b]Update 1.0.2[/b]

• Removed the small pond from the south-west area
• The south-east area now has NPC Barriers too, meaning animals can't escape 
• Removed some building tiles to make placing buildings a bit easier


[b]Features[/b]

• All grass is tillable 
• Animals can't escape the area with the ponds
• Pond behind the house serves as a neat water source 
• Replaces the Standard Farm


[u][b]Requirements
[/b][/u]• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets


[b][u]Installation
[/u][/b]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [b][CP] Pasture Woods Farm[/b] into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the [b]Standard Farm 

[/b]Enjoy!
